## Declared deviations

- p_naivejoint (§4.4 descriptor, Cao 2024 S17 analogue): spatial part = S1 (BrainSMASH) surrogates, the volumetric stand-in for spin; computed only for plants whose G2 matched (e3_plants.py @ef2f1ab), so it is missing wherever G2 is unmatched.
- p_J1_<pair> = max(p over the pair's two surrogate types) via Python max(), which returns the finite value if the second is NaN; J1_status tracks the joint pair only. A degenerate (sd_k) pool for one type but not the other cannot occur in practice; the count of J1_status == degenerate_pool is in MANIFEST.md.
- C-gene residualisation uses the first 3 PCs of the gene-z-scored (correlation) expression matrix; §6.3 does not say z-scored or centred.
- Level-1 surrogates, G-sets and J1 pools are drawn fresh per plant; C3 (e3_c3_gradients.py) shares one set of surrogates per (class, gradient) map across its sets, since the map is fixed there.
